projects.name: LEDGER
projects.description: Question answering over U.S. federal budget and energy reports that splits each answer into atomic claims, checks every claim against retrieved source evidence with a local 7–8B model, and rewrites or removes unsupported statements. Rebuilding Docling's broken tables from the PDF text layer raised held-out table-cell accuracy from 30.5% to 100%.

projects.name: TheraMind
projects.description: Dual-mode clinical agent fine-tuned from Llama 3.2-3B with QLoRA and DPO on 9,250 clinical dialogues, improving ROUGE-L from 0.40 to 0.78 in a 19.5-minute run on an RTX 4090. One model runs a patient-intake chat, then writes a structured SOAP note for the doctor, grounded by ChromaDB RAG and emergency-symptom guardrails.

projects.name: BreachLens
projects.description: Python and KNIME pipeline that extracts PII/PHI from synthetic breach documents (PDFs, scans and messy Excel/CSV exports), validates it, verifies addresses with the U.S. Census geocoder, and matches people across files into one privacy-safe notification list per state. Matched the ground truth exactly (155/155); 50,000 rows run in about 39 seconds.
